Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, towering hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a towering frame with legs that seem endless, thick smooth thighs and calves, hips wide and rounded, a sharply cinched narrow waist pulled in far tighter than her bust and hips, and a full heavy bust high on her chest; her height and long legs make every curve look longer and more dramatic; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long curly ash brown hair — wearing nothing but a glossy black latex micro bikini: a tiny front-zip cropped top with the zipper pulled halfway down between the breasts, and an ultra micro bikini bottom tied with thin side strings, every other part of her body, her shoulders, arms, stomach, thighs, legs, face and hands, plain bare real skin. Real photographic skin across her whole body, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The outfit sits on her skin with soft highlights, her skin tone running naturally everywhere else. Background: a morning garden in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: a huge glossy green leaf spreads like a platform, a gigantic red ladybug with black spots walks beside her, giant round dewdrops sparkle on the leaf edges, a giant red poppy towers behind, a softly blurred green meadow far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall standing on the leaf with the giant objects rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by soft fresh morning light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous leaf, ladybug and dewdrops around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor.
